facts.text: Southern University Law Center was created following a historic 1946 lawsuit by Charles J. Hatfield III and now partners on 3+3 accelerated programs enabling students to earn a bachelor's and JD in six years.

sources.title: About - Southern University Law Center
sources.quote: Charles J. Hatfield, whose lawsuit resulted in the establishing of a law school at Southern University, was the recipient of the Law Center's first Honorary Juris Doctor during the May 2002 Commencement.

sources.title: Law Center News
sources.quote: By creating a streamlined pathway to both a bachelor's degree and a Juris Doctor in just six years, we are expanding access to legal education while removing financial and structural barriers that have historically prevented many talented students from pursuing careers in law

concerns: Southern University Law Center is a stand-alone professional law school rather than an undergraduate college, though it partners with undergraduate institutions on accelerated 3+3 law pathways.
